jobs.prompt: Improve this top-down post-apocalyptic driving game screenshot. Change the camera from straight-down to a 3/4 tilted overhead angle (about 50 degrees from vertical, looking north) pulled back further so we see a whole city block, so building FACADES are visible, not just roofs. Same street: a battered police interceptor drifting down a cracked four-lane avenue in the ruins of Phoenix, black skid marks. Buildings now rise 2 to 6 storeys: a gutted six-storey concrete hotel with blown-out windows and a collapsed corner, rebar showing, a three-storey brick block with fire escapes and a hand-painted sign, rooftop water tanks, sandbagged rooftop sniper nest, corrugated-tin shanty additions bolted onto walls, laundry lines between buildings. Rusted car husks pushed into a barricade, a burnt bus, tumbleweeds, drifting dust, bullet-pocked walls, a scavenger crew of four survivors on foot behind the car, each holding a rifle or shotgun at the hip on their side. A road-pirate armored pickup with a welded plow chasing in the distance. Late afternoon long shadows. Keep it a REAL-TIME three.js game frame, not a painting or photo: stylized low-poly 3D with flat-shaded materials and procedural textures, crisp hard sun shadows, ambient occlusion in corners, warm dusty Arizona light, subtle bloom only on lights, slight film grain and a gentle vignette. Keep the existing stamped-steel game HUD exactly where it is (orders note top-left, compass strip top-center, clock and faction plates and cash plate top-right, radar dial and green highway sign and health/stamina and food/water/rest gauges and flag patch bottom-left, weapon/vehicle gauge panel bottom-right). No purple or violet anywhere. Palette: rust, sun-bleached sand, bone, oxidized teal, dried-blood red, amber.
